title: Django OTP Keygen
description:
A **configurable One-Time Password (OTP)** generator package built with Django. Supports multiple OTP formats — `DIGIT`, `TEXT`, and `MIXED` — with flexible expiry and retry policies. Published on **PyPI**.

Features:
- Abstract OTP model for reuse
- Customizable OTP types and validation
- Admin interface integration
- Unit tested and production ready

title: Django Admin Bulk IO
description:
A **bulk import/export tool** for Django Admin to simplify large dataset operations. Supports **CSV, JSON, and Excel** formats with custom field mapping.

Features:
- Admin action-based bulk import/export
- Async support with **Celery + Redis**
- Built-in validation layer
- Open-source and PyPI published

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description:
A full-stack **portfolio web application** showcasing skills, projects, and achievements.

Built using **Django REST Framework** for the backend API and **React + ShadCN UI** for the frontend. Fully responsive, SEO optimized, and deployed with **Docker + Nginx** on **AWS EC2**.

Features:
- REST API for projects, skills, and contact forms
- Modern React design with animations
- CI/CD via GitHub Actions
- Google Analytics + Sitemap + SEO ready

title: E-Commerce Platform API
description:
A scalable **e-commerce backend** with user authentication, product management, order tracking, and Stripe integration.

Features:
- **JWT authentication**
- **Stripe payments**
- Async order notifications using **Celery + Redis**
- Elasticsearch-based product search
- Dockerized microservice-ready setup

title: AI-Powered Resume Parser
description:
An **AI-powered resume parser** and matcher built with **FastAPI** and **LangChain**, integrating **OpenAI GPT models** for skill extraction and candidate-job matching.

Features:
- Extracts structured data from PDF resumes
- Uses GPT-based semantic skill mapping
- RESTful API with FastAPI
- Deployed on AWS Lambda with Docker support

title: Real-Time Chat App
description:
A **real-time chat application** using **Django Channels** and **React**, featuring WebSocket-based messaging and Redis pub/sub for scalability.

Features:
- Typing indicators, read receipts, and online status
- Authentication via JWT
- Message persistence with PostgreSQL
- Deployed via Docker + Nginx reverse proxy
